name: Ying Kee Tea House Group Ltd.
summary: Ying Kee Tea House Group Limited, founded in 1881 and based in Siu Sai Wan, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company, owned by Profit Ocean Enterprises Limited, that retails tea to individuals and corporate customers in Hong Kong. Its range includes pu-erh, green, black, white, oolong and jasmine teas, tea ware and gift sets, and it also holds property.
